items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: Lil would fall in when we were the small man Lil would fall on the piano then when he was in the plantation Russell would fall in then everybody gets to get on that

ctx.x: the tune you know some of the New Orleans fellas still do that just the trumpet player starts it right out now when the other guys fall in that's when he was

making up them tunes and that's why I say you see because then all 1925 24 Joe had so much I said Joe what I'm gonna do I'm going on and I'm gonna start studying so I know how to write these numbers down that you write this even before we could take a hand of all this music downs I'm gonna leave down like that so he's all the time kid music you're going down and take a hand because that's what he would do he'd come down there and sit down and he'd start to play in people being there we'd say Paul Morgan or Snaggs…
when you had the big band at the plantation after a while did they have those things arranged then did you ever have the music up in front of you?
